$comment: Canonical module types for the shift / sub-shift reading views.
A shift page is an ordered list of {type, data} modules; this file is the
contract between the pipeline (which emits them) and the front end (which
renders them). Adding a type means: add it here, emit it from the pipeline's
MODULE_TEMPLATE, and register a component in
apps/frontend/src/shift/modules.jsx. The front end skips unknown types, so a
new type can ship backend-first without breaking the page.

lede.summary: Opening line of a sub-shift page.

from_to.summary: The shift's spine as two cards whose gradient fills cross-fade.

from_to_solid.summary: From/To pair with solid green/pink fills (sub-shift variant).

stat_band.summary: Full-bleed band: oversized numeral, prose, source.

peel_tabs.summary: Two stacked cards the reader toggles: what's changing / why now.

sub_shift_list.summary: Cards linking to this shift's sub-shifts. Resolved from context, not data.

human_needs.summary: Two expanding cards: the need unlocked and the need threatened.

tension_band.summary: Dark full-bleed band carrying a pull-quote.

timeline.summary: Now / next / beyond, as a vertical timeline.

industries.summary: Sector chips plus a detail card that swaps on selection.

territories.summary: Opportunity-territory cards plus a work-with-us card.

signals.summary: Numbered evidence that the shift is real (sub-shift).

voices.summary: Who backs this shift and who disputes it, with their own words. Built at export from the thinker-attribution phase — no extra model spend.

evidence.summary: The sourced claims behind a sub-shift: what was said, by whom, where, and when. Distinct from `signals`, which is written prose.

related_shifts.summary: Typed links to other shifts (reinforces, accelerated_by, …) from the interrelatedness phase.

rich_text.summary: Escape hatch for editor-authored prose. Never generated.
